title: calamaria suksdorfii
intro: Calamaria suksdorfii, commonly known as Mountain Club Moss, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its ability to act as an expectorant. The health benefits of Calamaria suksdorfii include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are known to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
